run_search_bytestrings: run the search function to find candidate bytestrings matching a target hash within ideal hamming distance
calculate_hamming_distance: calculate the hamming distance between two equal-length strings using _get_hamming_distance
calculate_substring_hamming_distance: calculate the minimum hamming distance between a target and any substring of a candidate string
get_sha1_hash: get the base64-encoded SHA1 hash digest of a secret bytestring using _get_hash
generate_bytestrings: generate all bytestrings of a given length using _bytestrings_of_length or all bytestrings via _all_bytestrings
